name: RadioCard
description:
A radio as a tile: title, description and the radio circle. Used where each option
needs a sentence, typically in a dialog ("Interactive session · View and control the
device"). Chosen = accent-soft fill with an accent edge.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ title, description, icon, tone, className, ...rest }: RadioCardProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: description
props.description: One line that says what choosing this does ("View and control the device").

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional icon tile. Pass the icon without a size.

props.name: tone
props.description: The semantic tone. Use danger and warning for consequences and states.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to access the hidden input element.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the user should be unable to select the radio button.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: value
props.description: The unique identifying value of the radio in a group.
